creator: Alexander Terp
description: 2026-10-04 review: the message store now writes state.json with sync_data (not F_FULLFSYNC on macOS) and no directory sync. After a power loss the rename can land without the data, state.json reads unreadable, and the daemon starts from default: every participant's cursor resets and everything reads unread. Policy and pause come back from the log; cursors do not. Also: across.rs lately_reached is not dropped by drop_group/forget_replica, and home_daemon() picks the first non-tunnel backend by id, so a second local [[daemon]] could take msg open.
title: persist::replace after a power loss can leave state.json unreadable, resetting every cursor
